author: linda.hudterapeuten
title: Fantastically comfortable pads that give loads of moisture and glow instantly 🤩
body:
They are fragrance-free (yes, I’ve looked!), feel gentle on the skin, and provide a really plumping effect that makes the skin look more awake and fresh! (Also adding a post-routine picture including makeup)

The formula contains bioactive PDRN from salmon (Sodium DNA) which supports skin renewal and strengthens elasticity – yes please! (Clinical evidence and availability of vegan alternatives are unfortunately still limited.) Hyaluronic acid deeply hydrates while peptides help support skin structure and firmness. The collagen complex provides a smoothing, moisturizing effect on the surface that makes the skin softer and plumper.

For reference, I have an oily T-zone and sensitive, dry cheeks prone to rosacea. I use them both morning and evening, halve one pad ✂ and swipe over face, neck, décolleté, and backs of hands before serum. They also work perfectly as a quick sheet mask when you want to give your skin an extra boost 💦

The result is skin that feels hydrated, soft, and radiant — without irritation. A really lovely product for those who want glow, moisture, and plump without strong ingredients 🌟

 lindahudterapeuten

author: ceecilieeb
title: Lots of moisture and glow in one pad 💦✨
body:
I've been using the Anua PDRN 100 Hyaluronic Acid Glow Pad for a while now, and it has become a really nice step in my skincare routine.

The pads are well soaked with essence and feel cool and comfortable on the skin. I especially like how much moisture they provide without the skin feeling heavy or overloaded afterward.

My skin feels softer, more plumped, and looks fresher after use, with a nice glow that I actually notice. I also find them great to use before makeup when I want my skin to feel extra hydrated and even.

They can be used as regular toner pads, but I also like to leave them on my cheeks or other areas as a little mini-mask before moving on with the rest of my routine.

For me, this is primarily a really good moisturizing product that makes the skin comfortable, soft, and glowy – just the way I like it. 💦🤍
